newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Central Bank sells 99 bln rbls of bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russian Central Bank sells 99 bln rbls of bonds.

text.p: The Central Bank sold 99.00 billion roubles nominal of OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Friday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 24011 issue closed on Friday at 100.82 percent, and the 24012 issue closed at 99.20 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the Central Bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
